name: Valuable Vantages
summary: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to restore three signaling marks around Hillsbrad Foothills. Bat riders rely on those points to guide strategic troops to their drop-off sites.

sections.title: Three Peaks
sections.body: You carry Apothecary Vials to the hills beside Dun Garok, the plateau above Dunholde Keep, and the Headland ridge above Hillsbrad. Their vapors draw bats back to the signaling points, helping Masoj's high command guide its troops through the foothills.

sections.title: Masoj's Orders
sections.body: Masoj asks you to look for crushed, empty vials and renew the marks at all three locations. He calls the work part of the plans advancing under the Deathstalkers' banner.

faq.q: Who is asking me to place the vials?
faq.answer: Deathstalker Masoj asks you to restore the signaling marks around Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why are the signaling marks needed?
faq.answer: Bat riders use the signaling points to guide strategic troops to drop-off sites.

faq.q: Where do I place the vials?
faq.answer: The three locations are the hills beside Dun Garok, the plateau above Dunholde Keep, and the Headland ridge above Hillsbrad.

faq.q: What do the vial vapors do?
faq.answer: The vapors act as a signal that draws bats back to the desired drop-off points.
